pilot.rule: smallest epochs within 0.5 accuracy points of the best grid cell (mean over the two pilot tasks), then the best learning rate at those epochs

probe.test: 1,000 validation images x 5 presentations, a ~ N(0,1)

keys.image: index in the CIFAR-10 test set
keys.z_H: person H: plus network, mu = 1, half A
keys.z_H2: control H': plus network, mu = 1, half B
keys.z_M: machines, shape (len(lambdas), N), half B, frame independent of class
keys.val_*: the same on validation (val_image: CIFAR-10 training index)

manifest.layout: each image appears 5 times in a row (np.repeat), with independent frames
manifest.halves: the 9,000 training images of the task (validation excluded) split per class in two halves of 2,250 + 2,250 (A = first half of the same permutation that draws the validation set)
manifest.machine_training_frame: a ~ N(0, 2), independent of the class
manifest.penalty: lambda * Pearson correlation in the batch between sgn*z_M and sgn*z_H (sgn = +1 for class 1, -1 for class 0), after removing the mean of each true class in the batch; H frozen in eval mode, forward on the same augmented and framed batch (bf16); lambda = 0 trains without the term
manifest.frame: the outer 2-pixel border of all three channels is set to a * delta, in normalised units (after per-channel normalisation), applied after crop and flip, without clipping
manifest.torch_seeds: crc32('rephase/<task>/s<seed>/<H|H2|M>') & 0x7fffffff; every M_lambda of a unit shares seed, initialisation, batch order, crops, flips and frames
manifest.test_and_validation_frames: a = sqrt(2) * eps, eps from numpy default_rng(crc32('rephase/<task>/s<seed>/<test|val>-a'))

hyperparameters.network: Net of turing-meter experiments/angle-between-errors/gpu/silicon.py with a 2-way head: conv3x3 48-96, maxpool, 96-192, maxpool, 192, global average pool, linear; BatchNorm and ReLU after every convolution
hyperparameters.optimiser: SGD, Nesterov momentum 0.9, weight decay 5e-4, one-cycle schedule (PyTorch OneCycleLR defaults), bf16 autocast
hyperparameters.augmentation: random 32x32 crop of the image reflect-padded by 4 pixels, random horizontal flip

settings.bootstrap_weight: chosen again in each resample on 13 weights

H2a.rule: median Spearman(lambda, phi) >= 0.9 and, for at least one lambda, the phi interval above 90 degrees in every seed, in at least 3 tasks of 5

H2b.rule: some lambda > 0 with d_a(M_lambda) - d_a(M_0) < 0 and d_pair(H, M_lambda) - d_pair(H, M_0) > 0, both intervals excluding zero, in every seed; in >= 3 tasks of 5

H2c.rule: where the phi interval is above 90 degrees, the slope of M_lambda's cue on a has the sign opposite to H's

exploratory_null_positive_weight.note: Not in the protocol, added after seeing the data. Machines with lambda > 0 whose d_a is negative with its interval below zero: the signed turing of (H, M_lambda) at positive weights, where § 8 bis puts the null at w0 = 1/|k|. Interpolation as in E5; |Tu| at the predicted null with k from one half and the turing read on the other, as in H5b. The pair with the machine's cue reversed, (-k, -rho), is measured again: its apparent turing must be the same.
